calculate_circle_area: calculate the area of a circle that has a square and a circle inscribed in it given diagonal a
test_f_gold: test the f_gold function against f_filled using 10 parameter sets with a 0.001 relative error tolerance
run_evaluation: run the evaluation script to compare f_gold and f_filled results across all test parameters
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function which computes circle area using the formula pi times a squared divided by 4
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function that calculates inscribed circle area from a given diagonal value
